sloka: अहं वा कुम्भकर्णो वा त्वं वा सेनापतिर्मम ।इन्द्रजिद्वा निकुम्भो वा वहेयुर्भारमीदृशम् ।। ६.५७.६ ।।।।
transliteration: ahaṁ vā kumbhakarṇo vā tvaṁ vā senāpatirmama ।indrajidvā nikumbho vā vaheyurbhāramīdṛśam ।। 6.57.6 ।।।।

translations.english: "Either myself or Kumbhakarna, or my CommanderinChief, or you, or Indrajith, or Nikumbha can undertake such a burden."
